name: ARA-EXP-LNX-005
title: Linux Rust target missing
summary: Doctor did not find the Linux x64 GNU Rust target. This is a warning for template/native plugin development, not a requirement for a prebuilt-template export without plugins.
html:
Doctor did not find the Linux x64 GNU Rust target. This is a warning for template/native plugin development, not a requirement for a prebuilt-template export without plugins.

#Common causes

  • x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu is absent from the active Rust toolchain.

#Fixes

  • Run rustup target add x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.
